resources.string: Weather in your status bar — current temperature plus the next two hours, refreshed quietly in the background.

NotiWeather uses your approximate location to fetch weather from the free, open Open-Meteo API roughly every 15 minutes, then shows it as a small ongoing notification: the current temperature as the status bar icon, and your area\'s name, today\'s high/low, sunrise/sunset, and the next two hours when you expand it. No account, no ads, no analytics — the app only talks to Open-Meteo (weather) and OpenStreetMap\'s Nominatim (turning your coordinates into a place name).
Weather data by open-meteo.com · Place names by OpenStreetMap Nominatim
Location permission is needed to show local weather
Ongoing notification showing current and upcoming weather
